audience.text: Developers building 3D applications in Node.js who need to construct, traverse, and convert scene graphs using TypeScript or JavaScript.

capabilities.text: Build hierarchical 3D scenes using Scene, Node, and Entity types with support for transforms, materials, and child node relationships.
capabilities.title: Scene graph construction

capabilities.text: Create mesh geometry with control points, polygons, and vertex attribute channels including normals, UVs, and vertex colors.
capabilities.title: Mesh geometry creation

capabilities.text: Assign shading materials including LambertMaterial, PhongMaterial, and PbrMaterial with texture mapping support.
capabilities.title: Material assignment

capabilities.text: Add Camera and Light entities to scenes with configurable projection types, field of view, clip planes, and light types.
capabilities.title: Camera and light entities

capabilities.text: Animate node properties using AnimationClip, AnimationNode, AnimationChannel, and KeyframeSequence with configurable interpolation and extrapolation.
capabilities.title: Animation support

capabilities.text: Read and write 3D interchange formats including glTF, OBJ, STL, FBX, COLLADA, and 3MF through dedicated importers and exporters.
capabilities.title: Format I/O

capabilities.text: Perform 3D math operations using vector, matrix, and quaternion types with utilities for intersection tests and normal calculations.
capabilities.title: Math utilities

capabilities.text: Manage metadata and custom properties on scene objects using the Property and PropertyCollection APIs.
capabilities.title: Property system

limitations.text: Rendering is not implemented — Scene.render() throws an error.
Boolean operations on meshes (union, difference, intersect), optimize(), and isManifold() throw 'not implemented' errors.
VertexElement.setIndices() and clear() throw 'not implemented' errors.
Node.selectSingleObject() and selectObjects() throw 'not implemented' errors.
FileSystem virtualization abstraction methods (readFile, writeFile, createZipFileSystem, etc.) all throw errors.
OBJ export only writes geometry attached at the top of the scene graph; child node geometry is silently omitted.

problems_solved.text: Enables programmatic construction of 3D scenes with hierarchical node trees, mesh geometry, materials, cameras, and lights using a consistent API.
Supports reading and writing common 3D interchange formats including glTF, OBJ, STL, FBX, COLLADA, and 3MF through dedicated importers and exporters.
Provides animation support via keyframe sequences, interpolation, and extrapolation for animating node transforms and properties.
Offers utilities for mesh triangulation, bounding box calculations, and vector/matrix math operations for 3D geometry processing.

product_summary.text: Aspose.3D FOSS for TypeScript is a free, open-source TypeScript/JavaScript library for building, converting, and manipulating 3D scenes in Node.js without native bindings.

uncertainties: OBJ import does not currently assign per-face materials from the source file regardless of load option value — confirmed by direct testing against a real fixture.
Binary GLB export currently fails for any non-empty mesh; JSON/ASCII form is unaffected. Binary GLB import works correctly.
Re-importing a scene this library exported to glTF can come back with extra, duplicate top-level nodes not present in the original.
A real npm packaging defect affects 3MF import/export — a normal package install does not pull in a dependency the 3MF code path needs at runtime.
The package.json entry point does not match the actual build output, causing import resolution failures in published installs.
Text watermarking is not currently functional — the identical defect independently confirmed on the sibling 3d/net platform.

workflows.name: Load and save 3D scenes
workflows.text: Load a scene from a file or buffer using Scene.open() or Scene.openFromBuffer(), then save it to another format using Scene.save() or Scene.saveToBuffer().

workflows.name: Build mesh geometry
workflows.text: Create a Mesh, add control points, and define polygons using Mesh.addControlPoint() and Mesh.createPolygon(), then attach vertex elements for normals, UVs, and colors.

workflows.name: Construct animation clips
workflows.text: Create an AnimationClip, add AnimationNode tracks, bind AnimationChannel instances to properties, and populate KeyframeSequence with KeyFrame samples.

workflows.name: Apply materials to meshes
workflows.text: Instantiate material subclasses like LambertMaterial, PhongMaterial, or PbrMaterial, configure their properties, and assign them to Node.materials.

workflows.name: Triangulate polygon meshes
workflows.text: Use PolygonModifier.triangulate() on raw control points or call Mesh.triangulate() to convert existing mesh polygons to triangles.

workflows.name: Traverse scene hierarchy
workflows.text: Access the scene's root node and iterate through child nodes, entities, and their transforms using Scene.rootNode and Node.childNodes.
